Get medical institutions

Source: R/medical-institution-get.R
medical_institution_get.Rd

Returns the medical institutions of National Land Numerical Information (医療機関, P04) in a year, one row per institution, as published. The first call for a year downloads the file of that year's release (via ksjdata) and builds the table, which is then cached.

Usage

medical_institution_get(year)

Source

Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, National Land Numerical Information, 医療機関データ (P04): https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-P04-2020.html. See data_sources() for the terms of use.

Arguments

year

Reference year (fiscal year). See medical_institution_files() for the available years. The releases of 2010 and 2014 are left out, as they may not be used commercially.

Value

An sf tibble with one row per institution:

  • year, release: The reference year and the year of its release, which is year.

  • institution_type_code: 医療機関分類 (P04_001): "1" hospital (病院), "2" clinic (診療所), "3" dental clinic (歯科診療所).

  • institution_name, address: 施設名称 and 所在地, as published.

  • specialties_1, specialties_2, specialties_3: 診療科目 (P04_004 to P04_006), as published: the specialties separated by full-width spaces, continued in the second and third columns when they are too long for the first.

  • founder_type_code: 開設者分類 (P04_007) of hospitals: "1" national, "2" public, "3" social insurance organizations, "4" medical corporations, "5" individuals, "6" other, and "9" not classified (clinics and dental clinics).

  • beds: 病床数 (P04_008), the number of beds, as published.

  • emergency_code: 救急告示病院 (P04_009): "1" designated, "9" not.

  • disaster_base_code: 災害拠点病院 (P04_010): "1" core, "2" regional, "9" not designated.

  • geometry: The institution as a point, in JGD2011 (EPSG:6668).

Details

The institutions are the hospitals, clinics, and dental clinics of the Medical Care Act, including dormant ones and those inside companies, but not those that only visit.

The first time in a session, the terms of use are shown. Published or processed data must credit the source (National Land Numerical Information, 医療機関データ, by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism), and processed data must say that they were processed.

See also

medical_institution_target() to declare the table as a target.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
medical_institution_get(2020)
}
